response.overview: In a society where humans are born, reproduce, and die in 24 hours, a man named Harvey inexplicably lives day after day, amidst this endless cycle of birth, death, and rebirth. These are the daily chronicles of a man in the fit of evolution.
response.tagline: In a world that is born, lives, and dies every 24 hours, one man inexplicably endures.
response.title: Mayflies
